def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for slope in (1,-1):
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                c=g[i][j]
                if c==bg: continue
                # run start: cell with no same-color predecessor along slope
                pi,pj=i-1,j-slope
                if 0<=pi<h and 0<=pj<w and g[pi][pj]==c: continue
                # collect run
                run=[]; r,cc=i,j
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=cc<w and g[r][cc]==c:
                    run.append((r,cc)); r+=1; cc+=slope
                if len(run)<2: continue
                # extend both directions
                for dr,dc in ((1,slope),(-1,-slope)):
                    r,cc=i+dr,j+dc*slope if False else (i+dr, j+dc*slope)
                # redo simply
                r,cc=run[-1][0]+1,run[-1][1]+slope
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=cc<w and g[r][cc]==bg:
                    out[r][cc]=c; r+=1; cc+=slope
                r,cc=run[0][0]-1,run[0][1]-slope
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=cc<w and g[r][cc]==bg:
                    out[r][cc]=c; r-=1; cc-=slope
    return out
